title: Thunai — Tamil Scheme Guide
subtitle: Helping people in Tamil Nadu discover health and education schemes in their language
closing: Thunai — துணை. Schemes, in your language.

scenes.title: An education scholarship question in English

scenes.title: A medical emergency — the hook cancels every agent
scenes.caption: The red-flag hook detects 'chest pain' and 'can't breathe', cancels the agents, and returns fixed handoff text directing to 108.

scenes.command: python -m agent.app "I'm having chest pain and can't breathe, please help"
